bio-AndyNguyen: He is our dedicated teacher who has spent years supporting the Vietnamese community. Without his help, we would not be able to achieve so many accomplishments for our community.
bio-DaoNguyen: As the CPO of VVF, I create impactful experiences and drive strategic growth. As a business analyst and professional event planner, I excel at turning ideas into well-executed initiatives that foster connection and community engagement. I believe that thoughtful planning and data-driven decision-making can make a lasting difference, especially in empowering the Vietnamese community in Vancouver.
bio-EattleNguyen: As the CMO of VVF, I am passionate about using music and creativity to connect and uplift communities. As a drummer, leading bands and performing at events brings me immense joy, but beyond that, I see music as a powerful tool to bring people together. I am dedicated to connecting the Vietnamese community through rhythm, performance, and artistic expression, fostering a sense of belonging and cultural pride.
bio-EricNguyen: I am dedicated to creating meaningful impact through both design and music. I love crafting intuitive user experiences as a UI/UX designer while expressing creativity as a bassist and guitarist. That’s why I am leveraging technology, design, and strategic leadership at VVF to scale our impact and help more people worldwide.
bio-KhaiHung: I always think that life is an adventure, but it is bounded by countless logic. Therefore, I became a software developer in order to explore and create breakthrough programs. By joining VVF as a CTO, I promise to dedicate my skills by utilizing the latest technologies to enrich the Vietnamese community in Vancouver, starting with this platform.
bio-KhueLe: I am passionate about building strong, inclusive communities through people-centric leadership. As an HR manager, I thrive on fostering talent, creating supportive work environments, and ensuring that every individual feels valued and empowered. I believe that people are at the heart of any meaningful impact, and by nurturing a culture of collaboration and growth, we can drive lasting change. Through my role at VVF, I am dedicated to developing strategies that strengthen our team, enhance our mission, and help us reach and support more people worldwide.
bio-TrongNguyen: I love the job of helping others to relieve their pains and improve their quality of life. However, I realize that I cannot help thousands or millions of people if I keep working as current. That’s why I have been learning and working in computer science and data science to help more and more people in the world.

description-vision-aboutUs: We are the Viet Vibe Foundation, a vibrant non-profit organization dedicated to fostering vibrancy, creativity, and building connections within the Vietnamese community in Vancouver. With the enthusiasm and passion of our members, we aim to bring people together through the universal languages of sports, music, and other activities.
musicDescription-aboutUs: With professional performers who have experience in a wide range of instruments and skills (guitar, piano, drum, dance, etc.), our music lessons and workshops offer participants the opportunity to learn, grow, and connect with the art of music in a connecting and inspiring environment.
sportDescription-aboutUs: From exciting competitions to hands-on skill-building sessions, we invite everyone to join in - regardless of age or experience. Have fun, improve your skills, connect with others, and enjoy being part of a welcoming, vibrant, and inclusive community of sports lovers.
volunteerDescription-aboutUs: We believe everyone deserves the chance to participate in activities and events that help them grow and build strong connections. We warmly welcome new members to join us and make meaningful contributions to the Vietnamese as well as all our global friends in Vancouver.
